+# Vendored from typing-inspection: typing_inspection/introspection.py
+def is_typealiastype(tp: Any) -> bool:
+    """Return whether the provided argument is an instance of `TypeAliasType`.
+
+    Works for both `typing.TypeAliasType` and `typing_extensions.TypeAliasType`,
+    without requiring either to be importable on every Python version.
+    """
+    tp_type = type(tp)
+    return tp_type.__name__ == "TypeAliasType" and tp_type.__module__ in (
+        "typing",
+        "typing_extensions",
+    )
+
+
+def unwrap_typealiastype(annotation: Any) -> Any:
+    while is_typealiastype(annotation):
+        annotation = annotation.__value__
+    return annotation
+
+
 def value_is_sequence(value: Any) -> bool:
     return isinstance(value, sequence_types) and not isinstance(value, (str, bytes))
